description:
Clueso's design guide, animation guide and animation stdlib. Ask for everything you need in ONE call. Each select entry is a section path or plain words; words search the design guide, animation guide and stdlib together and return the best few, each labelled with the path that selects it exactly.

  get_design_guide({select: ['gist', 'styles.kinetic-type', 'motion.*', 'animation.contract', 'stagger from the centre']})

Paths: 'gist' (the design gist and its contents; also what no arguments returns); design sections ('motion.camera', 'x.*' with its children, '*' for all); 'animation.gist' (the animation guide's gist and contents), 'animation' (its core) or 'animation.<path>'; 'stdlib' (its modules), 'stdlib.<module>' or 'stdlib.<member>' ('stdlib.native.tween'). Start with select ['gist', 'animation.gist', ...] for both gists. One header per entry; anything past the size budget is listed by path for your next call. (topic/query still work.)

Brand: pass project_id (or brand_kit_id) and the reply starts with a short 'brand' section: the brand kit's palette by role, each font role's exact font_setting, its logos (id, kind, for_background, aspect, url) and its guidelines. Follow it by default. 'brand.<section>' returns one section in full as JSON with its edit link: overview, company (product knowledge), palette, logos, fonts, reference_images, guidelines, icons, captions, voices; 'brand.*' for all. Use an item by reference: a logo → add_elements element_type 'image' with src = that logo's url (match for_background to what is behind it; never recolor); a color role → its hex (palette.accent); a font role → its font_setting. List kits with find(type='brand_kits'); set a project's kit with update_project brand_kit_id. Building from a clueprint: pass its clueprint_id too, and the brand section says which of the two decides what (the kit: identity; the clueprint: format).

brand_kit_id.description: Read this brand kit (an id from find(type='brand_kits'), or 'default') instead of the project's: for a project on another kit, or a co-branded scene.

clueprint_id.description: The clueprint this project is built from: the brand section then says what it decides (format) and what the kit decides (identity), and whether it is brand_locked.

project_id.description: The project you are designing: adds its brand kit (the project's own, else the workspace default) as the 'brand' section.

query.description: With topic 'stdlib': what to search for.

select.description: Everything to return, in one list: section paths and plain words, mixed. 'brand' and 'brand.<section>' read the brand kit.

topic.description: Older form; select covers it. 'animation': the animation guide's gist. 'stdlib': search with query.

name: get_design_guide
title: Get design guide
